texts.title: Hillview Park Campsite — information for guests

paragraphs.text: Arrivals are accepted between 2 pm and 8 pm. If you expect to arrive later, please phone the site office, otherwise your pitch may be given to another guest.
Each pitch has space for one tent and one car. Additional cars must be left in the visitors’ car park near the entrance, for which there is no charge.
Dogs are welcome but must be kept on a lead at all times. They are not allowed in the shower blocks or the children’s play area.
Campfires are not permitted anywhere on the site. Guests may use their own barbecues, provided these are raised off the ground.
Quiet hours are from 10.30 pm to 7 am. Please leave your pitch by 11 am on the day of departure.
The site shop sells basic food, gas for camping stoves and ice. It is open from 8 am to 6 pm, and fresh bread can be ordered the evening before.
